story.ui.quest.log.title: Quest Log
story.story.loc_intro_river.0.text: You were once the Prince of the Underworld. Your own shadows betrayed you and cast you into death.
story.story.loc_intro_river.1.text: And yet, even here at the edge of oblivion, I still see power within you.
story.story.loc_intro_river.2.text: I grant you a second chance. Not as mercy, but because this world still needs a savior.
story.story.loc_intro_river.3.text: Your punishment is simple: rise, and save what you never wished to protect.
story.story.loc_intro_river.4.text: ~You hear water and wind. Your body lies half-buried in the cold riverside grass.~
story.story.loc_intro_river.5.speaker: Brave Villager
story.story.loc_intro_river.5.text: Over there, by the riverbank. Someone is lying there!
story.story.loc_intro_river.6.speaker: Village Guard
story.story.loc_intro_river.6.text: He is badly hurt... and still it feels like darkness is clinging to him.
story.story.loc_intro_river.7.speaker: Village Protector
story.story.loc_intro_river.7.text: Take him to River Village. If he can stand, he might still be able to fight.
story.story.loc_intro_river.8.text: ~Before you can answer, a pack bursts out from the reeds along the bank.~
story.quest.quest_main_001.title: Travel to River Village
story.quest.quest_main_001.description: Reach River Village and get your first look at the crisis unfolding there.
story.quest.quest_main_002.title: Defeat the Goblin Chief
story.quest.quest_main_002.description: Follow the river path and eliminate the goblin chief leading the raids.
story.event.event_village_arrival.title: Arrival at River Village
story.event.event_village_arrival.step.0.text: This is River Village. If the pressure keeps rising, the whole region will fall with it.
story.event.event_village_arrival.step.0.choic: Then I will speak with your elder.
story.event.event_village_arrival.step.1.text: He is waiting in the square. If anyone knows where these monsters are coming from, it is him.
story.event.event_elder_intro.title: The Village Elder
story.event.event_elder_intro.step.0.speaker: Village Elder
story.event.event_elder_intro.step.0.text: The attacks grow worse each week. Not only more frequent, but fiercer. Even our seasoned people barely make it back alive.
story.event.event_elder_intro.step.1.speaker: Village Elder
story.event.event_elder_intro.step.1.text: Something powerful is gathering along the river path. We believe a goblin chief is driving the pack. Find him and end this hunt.
story.ui.quest.accept.viaDialog: Speak with someone in the village to accept this quest.
